capabilities._note: Video to sound: MMAudio (large 44k v2) through kijai's ComfyUI-MMAudio, its frames taken by time by seriesmith's SeriesmithMMAudioSampler (comfy_nodes/mmaudio.py): the pack's own sampler takes the first 8 x seconds frames as its 8 fps CLIP frames and the first 25 x seconds as its 25 fps sync frames, so from a 24 fps take the model saw its first third, stretched, and its sync 4% slow and cut short. Heard 2026-11-01 the pack's way: it hit the marks, the sounds not as good (docs/SOUND.md 'Models', Foley); `frames` in the preset says which way. MIT weights.

binding._note: The take goes up as a file (LoadVideo, its frames by GetVideoComponents), 512 wide at its own frame rate (fx.stage). MMAudioModelLoader (large 44k v2, fp16), MMAudioFeatureUtilsLoader (its VAE, synchformer and CLIP, 44k; BigVGAN v2 from models/mmaudio/nvidia: `fetches`), SeriesmithMMAudioSampler at 25 steps, cfg 4.5, the take's frame rate and seconds, SaveAudio.

presets._note: MMAudio's own settings (25 steps, cfg 4.5), as the beds use; the picture 512 wide at its own frame rate; its frames by time.

final.negative: music, speech, talking, voices, singing, noisy, harsh

fetches._note: ComfyUI-MMAudio's MMAudioFeatureUtilsLoader (44k mode) fetches NVIDIA's BigVGAN v2 vocoder by itself into models/mmaudio/nvidia/bigvgan_v2_44khz_128band_512x when that folder isn't there (snapshot_download, the whole repo: 4 GB with the training checkpoints it never reads). The Features window downloads the two files it reads instead, and the target isn't ready without them (seriesmith/hubcache.py).

downloads._note: The files ComfyUI-MMAudio's README points to (huggingface.co/Kijai/MMAudio_safetensors, listed 2026-11-01). Its node pack is https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-MMAudio (features.PACKS).
